body.name: M_N
body.def: on \(\{\mathbb P_N\in\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}\}\), \(M_N=\mathfrak M_T(\mathbb P_N)\) from the full-rank recursion, ordered as outcome means, message means, centered outcome variances, upper-triangular message Gram products, mean-score Jacobians, and variance-score Jacobians; set \(M_N=0\) on the complementary event
